# Security Policy

## Supported Version

Security updates are made on the `main` branch. Older commits, forks, local modifications,
and generated OPSI packages aren't supported release lines.

## Report a Vulnerability Privately

Report suspected vulnerabilities through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Schweinhitti/auto-opsi-repo/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected component, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested mitigation.

Don't open a public issue or pull request for a vulnerability. Don't disclose vulnerabilities,
tokens, credentials, private URLs, installer evidence containing secrets, or other sensitive
data in public repository content.

This project doesn't promise a response or remediation SLA and doesn't operate a bug bounty
program. Reports will be assessed based on maintainer availability and project risk.

For deployment trust boundaries and incident guidance, read the repository's
[security documentation](../docs/SECURITY.md).
